metadata.title: Security Monitoring SSPP
metadata.remarks: This SSPP defines how security telemetry is continuously observed, correlated, and contextualized to provide situational awareness for Security Operations. It explicitly separates observation from detection, decision, and response.

import-profile.remarks: This SSPP inherits authority, workflow, escalation, and telemetry requirements and SHALL NOT redefine those concerns.

system-characteristics.system-description: Defines requirements for continuous observation and correlation of security-relevant telemetry to maintain situational awareness without declaring maliciousness or initiating response.

system-implementation.remarks: Security monitoring provides visibility and context only. Monitoring outputs SHALL inform detection and response but SHALL NOT independently trigger actions.

monitoring-scope.description: Observation of authentication, authorization, and privilege-use behavior.
Observation of host, process, service, and configuration activity.
Observation of network connections, flows, and protocol activity.
Observation of application and platform behavior relevant to security context.

monitoring-requirements.statement: Security-relevant telemetry SHALL be continuously observed for context and pattern identification.
Monitoring SHALL correlate telemetry across domains to surface cross-system activity patterns.
Monitoring outputs SHALL include contextual information sufficient to support downstream detection analysis.
Security Operations SHALL maintain visibility into monitoring coverage and blind spots.

blind-spot-handling.statement: Gaps in monitoring coverage SHALL be explicitly identified and documented.
Persisting blind spots SHALL escalate as control violations under the Violation & Drift Escalation SSPP.

control-implementation.description: Controls ensure that monitoring supports situational awareness, detection analysis, and governance oversight.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Systems are monitored for security-relevant activity.
Audit and monitoring information is correlated and reviewed to support situational awareness.
Continuous monitoring supports ongoing security assessment.

statements.statement: Security Monitoring SHALL NOT declare incidents or initiate response actions.
Monitoring outputs SHALL be advisory inputs to Threat Detection, not decisions.
Operational convenience SHALL NOT justify reduced monitoring coverage.
Monitoring blind spots SHALL be treated as security control failures.

back-matter.remarks: Downstream SSPPs for Threat Detection, Incident Response, SOAR, and Digital Forensics SHALL rely on monitoring outputs defined by this SSPP.
